report.summary: crates/editor-snippets rev 2: SnippetPlan binds an expansion to a DocumentId (caller revision id + FNV-1a content hash of exact bytes) and an Anchor (caret or selection), with typed Staleness (Fresh/RevisionMismatch/ContentMismatch) catching bytes changed under an unchanged revision id. Anchor offsets are validated as char boundaries against the exact document text passed to SnippetPlan::compute (PlanError::InvalidOffset/SelectionReversed), tested with CJK, accented Latin, and a multi-codepoint ZWJ emoji sequence. Rev 1 placeholders/linked edits/tab order/self-referential detection and all six limits.rs bounds are unchanged and re-verified through the plan API. SnippetPlan exposes only compute() (shared refs + owned Anchor, never &mut anything document-shaped) plus getters and a pure staleness comparison -- no apply/commit method exists, so caller application is required by the API surface, not documentation. 41 rev-1 tests + 17 new plan tests + 2 doc-tests, all passing; cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings clean; cargo fmt --check clean.
